differences.impact: PG 17 may have different planner heuristics, but the core HNSW/IVFFLAT index behavior is the same
Different OS page cache behavior, different memory allocation patterns, different disk I/O characteristics

conclusion: The PostgreSQL configuration is essentially identical between canonical and current environments. The main differences are PostgreSQL version (16.14 vs 17.10) and OS (Debian Docker vs macOS native). Neither difference explains the HNSW recall discrepancy, which must be due to index construction differences (graph quality).
